chapter: Television, the stroke and later reflections
title: Ted Lewis as shadow at the Club Bimbo in San Francisco
summary: He subbed for Ted Lewis' shadow dancer in Me and My Shadow on a two-week date; an audience member asked which was the shadow.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Now, I didn't get to tell you about doing a show with Ted Lewis. Did I tell you about the Ted Lewis show? I was his shadow. He used to have a boy called Charlie Witty and Charlie Witty and him got into some kind of difficulty and he thought he'd take me to substitute for Charlie Witty so I went along with him to Frisco for a two-week contract at the Club Bimbo and I worked with him, doing

"Me and My Shadow." Somebody one night hollered from the balcony, "Which one is the shadow?" Now Ted Lewis is white and I'm black. But someone hollered out, "Which one is the shadow?" So we must have been doing pretty good with it.
You did that same routine with Judy Garland.
Yeah. And that was in Frisco and after we leave the Bimbo club which was booked by Associated Booking office.
